title: Spiral Walk
commonMistakes: Printing the first row twice when the grid has a single row
Overwriting values while traversing instead of using boundaries
Forgetting to shrink the bottom or left boundary after a pass
Returning an empty array for a non-empty grid
followUps: How would you generate an `n x n` matrix in spiral order?
How would you traverse the matrix counter-clockwise?
How would you handle a sparse matrix without visiting empty cells?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
